title: RetrievalRouter: Joint Modality and Architecture Selection for Document Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.25625v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Document retrieval increasingly supports high-stakes information access in finance, healthcare, and law. Modern retrieval pipelines vary both in modality (text or multimodal) and in retrieval architecture (dense or late-interaction). These choices impose a hard compromise: the most effective pipelines are too slow and expensive to run at scale, while the fastest fail to retrieve evidence from complex documents. Practitioners must therefore choose between missed evidence and unusable latency, with no principled basis for adapting that choice at the query level. We show that this compromise is unnecessary. Not every query requires the same pipeline. Across benchmarks spanning financial and scientific corpora, no static pipeline dominates. We introduce RetrievalRouter, a lightweight query-aware router that learns, from the query text alone, which retrieval pipeline best fits each query. translated_title: 检索路由器：文档检索中的联合模态与架构选择
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25625v1 公告类型：新 摘要：文档检索日益支持金融、医疗和法律领域中的高风险信息访问。现代检索流程在模态（文本或多模态）和检索架构（稠密或后期交互）方面各不相同。这些选择带来了艰难的权衡：最有效的流程在大规模运行时过于缓慢且昂贵，而最快的流程却无法从复杂文档中检索到证据。因此，从业者必须在遗漏证据和不可用的延迟之间做出选择，且没有基于查询级别调整该选择的原则性依据。我们表明这种权衡并非必要。并非每个查询都需要相同的流程。在跨越金融和科学语料库的基准测试中，没有静态流程占据主导地位。我们引入了检索路由器，这是一种轻量级的查询感知路由器，仅从查询文本中学习哪个检索流程最适合每个查询。单个可调参数暴露了完整的准确性-延迟权衡曲线。
tldr: 检索路由器是一种轻量级查询感知路由器，通过动态选择每个查询的最佳模态和检索架构，在无需静态权衡的情况下优化文档检索的准确性和延迟。
en_tdlr: RetrievalRouter is a lightweight query-aware router that dynamically selects the optimal modality and retrieval architecture for each query, optimizing accuracy-latency trade-offs in document retrieval without static compromises.
